techniques.evidence: src/types/economy-simulator.ts:59 The band verdict itself is realized (BalanceBandResult has a canon-read tolerance, a basis and unspecified/not-measured states), but the input type has no way to record an unestimated frequency, which the band's representation rule forbids.
src/types/economy-simulator.ts:20 Five-kind vocabulary, converter input legs required, unclassified reported and never absorbed.
src/types/economy-simulator.ts:89 EconomyLoop needs polarity, a gain (or 'uncharacterised'), a latency and a path.

src/types/economy-simulator.ts:148 The audit flags nodes whose declared throughput the structure cannot supply (a drain that never fires) and blocks a pass. This is checked on the stochastic run, not a separate deterministic unit-rate walk.
src/types/economy-simulator.ts:234 Gini is computed per level; the engine warns above 0.6 and goes critical above 0.8, and price-imbalance alerts exist.

pairs.registryProposal: tornado-sensitivity-sweeps is generic (any multi-lever model), and this repo applies it to combat attribute sweeps; the golden path gives combat validation to encounter-balance, so which subject owns non-economy sensitivity sweeps should be stated explicitly.
